scripts.remindctl: pnpm run --reporter=silent version:sync && swift package clean && swift run remindctl
scripts.lint: swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests && swiftlint --strict && shellcheck -x scripts/*.sh && actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.check: pnpm run --reporter=silent lint && pnpm run --reporter=silent coverage
scripts.build: pnpm run --reporter=silent version:sync && mkdir -p bin && swift build -c release --product remindctl && cp .build/release/remindctl bin/remindctl && codesign --force --sign - --identifier com.steipete.remindctl bin/remindctl
